prompt: Otemachi Edge Center says it is 100% renewable. Is that true hour by hour for August?
actual_response:
No, Otemachi Edge Center is not 100% renewable on an hour-by-hour basis for August month-to-date (2026-08-01 through 2026-08-19). While their annual-style volumetric match score is 110.4%, their true 24/7 hourly Carbon-Free Energy (CFE) score is only 66% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers]. 

Here is the breakdown of their performance:
*   **Volumetric vs. Hourly Gap:** They contracted 11930.9 MWh of clean energy against a total load of 10803.7 MWh [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers]. However, daytime solar excesses cannot offset night-time deficits, leaving 5233.4 MWh uncounted in hourly matching [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, desk_policy_guide.md Section 8].
*   **24/7 CFE Score Composition:** The 66% score comes from a 62% contracted hourly-matched share plus a 4% grid carbon-free contribution on the unmatched remainder [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
*   **Weakest Hours:** Out of 447 evaluated hours, 215 hours fell below a 50% match rate [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers]. The weakest hours are 20:00-21:00 at 22.6%, 21:00-22:00 at 22.8%, and 22:00-23:00 at 23.2% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
